content: The time-dependent Bregman potential R_{a_t} with a_{t,i}=2u_{0,i}v_{0,i} exp(-2 ∫_0^t α_s ds) and the mirror-flow identity d∇R_{a_t}(x_t) = -∇f(x_t)dt give the schedule α_t direct control over the scale a_t, over the global minimum of R_{a_t} (at x = exp(-2 ∫_0^t α_s ds) ⊙ m_0 ⊙ w_0), and over the asymptotic implicit-bias strength (R_a(x) ~ log(1/a) ||x||_{L_1} as a→0 and |x/a|→∞); hence the schedule controls the strength and position of the implicit bias.
